incidents.summary: Hays Specialist Recruitment was named by the government for failing to pay £8,987.62 in minimum wages to 450 workers and was required to repay the arrears.

sources.quote: The global firm, Hays Specialist Recruitment was named for failing to pay £8,987.62 to 450 workers.

sources.title: Global Recruitment firm one of the companies named and shamed by government - HRreview | HR News, Opinion & Advice
sources.quote: The businesses named have since had to pay back what they owe to staff and also face significant financial penalties of up to 200 percent.

incidents.summary: A worker injured while removing rubbish received damages against Hays for failure to train him in a safe system of work, and Hays's appeal was rejected in 2025.

sources.title: Employers stung in payout appeal after wasp wrong-foots worker - Insurance News - insuranceNEWS.com.au
sources.quote: In March last year, the Queensland Supreme Court awarded him $503,595 against Hays and $873,014 against Civeo, ruling there was a failure to train him in a safe system of work.

sources.quote: When he was startled by the wasp, he tripped backwards over a bag and injured his arm, requiring hospital care and surgery.

sources.title: Employers stung in payout appeal after wasp wrong-foots worker - Insurance News - insuranceNEWS.com.au
sources.quote: Labour hire company Hays Specialist Recruitment and accommodation provider Civeo lost their appeal against damages owed to Aaron Carey-Schofield, who sued them alleging a breach of their duty of care to take precautions against risk of harm.
